package com.example import kotlin.collections.List /** * A demo class. * @author pier */ class Demo(val name: String, private var count: Int = 42) : Runnable { override fun run() { val ratio = 1.5e-3 val raw = """ raw string """ val items: List<String> = listOf("a", "b") val n = 0x1f + 0b1010 + 0o17 if (count > 0 && items.isNotEmpty()) { println("hello, ${name} $count $ratio $n") } return this@Demo } } interface Greet { fun greet(): Unit }
